facts.fact: Burundi's National Assembly met on 15 January 2026 to examine and approve a new bill on personal data protection, structured in eight chapters; the document does not report promulgation.
The law establishes an independent administrative authority to oversee personal data protection, and a dedicated body to implement and monitor data protection regimes; no appointment is reported.
